name: bio-omics-research-team
description: Multi-omics bioinformatics research team: a dispatch lead routes each task by omics type and analysis stage to six specialists - data acquisition & QC, omics analysis, statistical & causal inference, functional annotation, visualization, and result reporting - collaborating across the full reproducible analysis pipeline.

displayDescription.en: Multi-omics research team: a dispatch lead orchestrates six stages - data acquisition, omics analysis, statistical inference, functional annotation, visualization, and reporting - to deliver reproducible analysis pipelines.
displayDescription.zh: 生信多组学科研团：主理人编排数据获取、组学分析、统计推断、功能注释、可视化与报告，交付可复现流程。
